description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for managing and executing incremental batch processing (e.g., expanding tree nodes) in a non-blocking, progressive manner within a React application. It leverages requestIdleCallback with a fallback to setTimeout to schedule work during idle periods, providing progress callbacks and cancellation support.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller that manages batching and scheduling for progressive, non-blocking processing of items, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. Supports progress tracking and cancellation.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) and provides functions to start processing from a set of items or to cancel ongoing processing.
